children: Strength in mining stocks doesn't hinge on data center demand, says Jefferies. "Data centers are a nice theme, but we do not need a massive data-center boom for this sector to outperform," says the bank. "We just need a healthy economy." To be sure, that may depend somewhat on data center construction. Yet Jefferies says "there are longer term fundamental tailwinds at play now due to a lack of mine supply growth even if data center buildout is slower than many had previously assumed." Industrial commodity prices should be strong and mining share prices outperform broader equity markets so long as the global industrial economy grows roughly in line with consensus expectations, it says.
